definition: SensitivityModels constructs six interpretations on the explicit three-constructor Small type. Each has exactly one Form and therefore no unbounded list of distinct Forms, retains the other named assumptions, and negates the selected omitted principle. These are compatibility/countermodels of encodings, not theories of real explanatory power.
